text: Nancy Guthrie: Glove found in desert search as authorities sift through tips | FOX 10 PhoenixThe Pima County Sheriff’s Department has received nearly 18,000 leads in the 11 days since Nancy Guthrie’s disappearance, including 4,000 tips submitted in the 24 hours following the release of suspect surveillance footage. Authorities briefly detained and questioned delivery driver Carlos Palazuelos after a Tuesday night traffic stop because he reportedly resembled the man in the video. Palazuelos was released without charges Wednesday morning. In the Catalina Foothills, search teams located a glove Wednesday that appears to match one worn by the suspect in the FBI footage. Investigators have not yet confirmed a forensic link between the item and the abduction. FOX 10's Nicole Krasean and Taylor Wirtz have the details.
